claim.value: Inaccurate availability entries are a possible contributor to late starts.
claim.scope: A hypothesis to investigate, not an established contributor.

provenance.rationale: The span explicitly identifies inaccurate availability entries as a hypothesized contributor.

signal_basis.value: Linked booking and turnaround records show recurring readiness delays despite calendar availability, with equipment status assessed at the scheduled start and ambiguous cases left unresolved.
signal_basis.scope: The relevant readiness-delay signal is assumed observed using consistent event definitions. It supports investigating an availability mismatch; it does not identify its cause or establish causal contribution to late starts.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the record-linking operation, measurement distinctions, scheduled-start assessment, relevant recurring mismatch and explicit limit on causal interpretation.
The judgment is SUPPORTED; no conditional empirical-relation component applies.

rationale: Recurring unreadiness when the calendar indicates availability licenses investigating inaccurate availability entries as a possible contributor. The frozen claim asserts only a hypothesis, so it does not require the observations to establish causation or exclude competing explanations.
uncertainty: The observations do not establish whether inaccurate entries contributed to late starts or whether the mismatch arose from another turnaround problem.
